APIs for creating and destroying instruction test execution contexts.

# Purpose
`fd_instr_harness.h` declares the test harness API used to create and destroy instruction execution contexts for runtime tests. It includes `fd_solfuzz.h` and `generated/invoke.pb.h`, then exposes [`fd_runtime_fuzz_instr_ctx_create`](<#fd_runtime_fuzz_instr_ctx_create>) to build an `fd_exec_instr_ctx_t` from a test runner and an `InstrCtx` protobuf, with the `is_syscall` flag used to skip checks that apply only to program instructions. It also declares [`fd_runtime_fuzz_instr_ctx_destroy`](<#fd_runtime_fuzz_instr_ctx_destroy>) to release the context after use. The include guard prevents multiple inclusion of the header file.
# Function Declarations (Public API)

---
- `fd_runtime_fuzz_instr_ctx_create`
- `fd_runtime_fuzz_instr_ctx_destroy`
